_doc: K: shared controls Settings asked for (settings-12, 13): the v70 .bt text button, the .ib icon button and the .cfsw switch. Deep-merged into design-tokens.json's lumaui object; px unless the key says otherwise.

text_button._doc: v70 .bt: 36 tall, padding 0 12 (the key 0 14), 10 round, 7 between a 16 glyph and 13/500 words; .sm 28 tall, padding 0 9, 8 round, 12 at .01em.

icon_button._doc: v70 .ib: 36 square, 10 round, an 18 glyph in ink-2 (fill-1 and ink on hover, fill-2 when on); in a settings row .cfcp 28 with 14; in a group heading .cfgrp h6 .ib 26 with 15.

switch._doc: v70 .cfsw / .cksw / .cwin .sw: a 38x22 pill with a 16 round knob 3 in (on: 19 from the left), the island's fill in a well edge off, the accent well on with a white knob; big 44x26 with a 20 knob.
